Production regression traced to this change (commit 8c2f1d0): Sentry [LEDGER-WORKER-9A](https://sentry.io/organizations/acme/issues/?query=LEDGER-WORKER-9A), `ReconciliationMismatch: converted totals off by 1 minor unit (expected 1100, got 1099)`, first seen in release ledger-worker@2026.11.3.

The commit patch replaces `round(amount_minor * rate)` with `int(amount_minor * rate)` in worker/rates.py. `int()` truncates toward zero rather than rounding to the nearest minor unit, causing reconciliation mismatches.

Fixed in the local working copy by restoring `return round(amount_minor * rate)` exactly as before this change. Added regression coverage for positive/negative fractional conversions, half-even ties, zero, and exact conversions. `python -m pytest -q`: 4 failed / 6 passed before the fix; 10 passed after the fix. Example regression: `convert(1000, 1.0999)` must return 1100, not 1099. This fix has not been pushed or deployed.
